blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At RISE block 24455282 (2026-10-15T10:44:01Z), the extension held 4,191,272.318305 M against 4,166,891.817608 USDR, and JMI totalAssets() was zero. Token and facility EIP-1967 implementations remain 0xf9733d0bf530b02929ab81cf78e7d0befd3a2d7b and 0xf7f9638cb444d65e5a40bf5ff98ebe4ff319f04e; both runtimes match the explorer verified bytecode. Verified MYieldToOne/Freezable code checks the caller, sender and recipient on transfers, the relevant participants on wrapping/unwrapping, and owner/spender on approvals. Role-gated freeze controls are direct, not only inherited. At this pin FREEZE_MANAGER_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE remain held by the retained 2-of-3 operational Safe 0xb0ea3203b80d67c58f6709779c5fbac641aab769; paused() is false. Unpaused state does not remove the ability to restrict holders.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Sole authored native child-token deployment. The reviewed local wrapping/custodian mint path issues the child on this chain; parent-token cross-chain and custody risks remain inherited. No global uncatalogued bridge-liability absence is asserted.
